simplebuilding.blueprint.help.open: Help: code guide and block list
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.pick: Click: select it for Insert below the code
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.1: One statement per line: a block, then one or more positions. # starts a comment.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.2: Position: x,y,z (x = east, y = up, z = south), each 0..255.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.3: Range: a..b on any axis, both ends included. stone 0..4,0,0..4 is a 5x1x5 plate.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.4: Corner form: stone 1,1,1..1,1,5 fills from one corner to the other.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.5: Properties: oak_stairs[facing=east,half=top] 0,3,0 - properties left out keep their default.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.6: Repeat: oak_fence 0,1,0*5@2,0,0 places 5 copies, each 2 blocks further along x.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.7: air clears what earlier lines placed: air 1..3,1..3,1..3 hollows out a box.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.8: Alias: $roof = oak_stairs[facing=north], then use it as $roof 0..4,4,0.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.9: Later lines overwrite earlier ones. minecraft: may be left out; blocks of other mods need their prefix.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.10: The Blocks tab and the search below the code show every block's ID: select one, then press Insert.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.11: Shapes instead of positions: sphere(8,8,8,5) (centre, radius), dome(8,0,8,5), cylinder(4,0,4,3,6) and pyramid(4,0,4,3,4) (base centre, radius, height), box(0,0,0,5,4,5) (corner, size), line(0,0,0..9,4,2). Given a box instead, e.g. sphere(0..9,0..5,0..9), they fill the same figure as an octant.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.12: hollow_ in front keeps only the shell: hollow_sphere(8,8,8,5), hollow_box(0,0,0,5,4,5). Shapes repeat like positions: stone sphere(2,2,2,1)*3@5,0,0.
simplebuilding.blueprint.help.guide.13: Variables: $r = 5, then $r works in positions, sizes and repeat counts, with + - * / % and brackets: $h = $r * 2 + 1, stone 0..$r,0,$h-1. In a position write multiplication in brackets, ($r*2), because * starts a repetition.

jei.simplebuilding.info.elytra_pad: Hands a Spawn Elytra to players with an empty chest slot in its area and recharges it. Area per tier: 1x1, 5x5, 16x16, 32x32 and 128x128 blocks (height 15 to 127); from Enderite (IV) on, boosts recharge in the whole area. Tier I is smithed from any template, a diamond pressure plate and an elytra.
jei.simplebuilding.info.flypad: Grants creative flight inside its area and takes it back outside. Three enderite tiers: 4x4x6, 8x8x12 and 16x16x24 blocks; leaving the area while flying gives 10 s of Slow Falling.
jei.simplebuilding.info.spawn_teleporter: Stand still on it to travel to the spawn target (set by operators, otherwise the world spawn): 50 s on tier I, 20 s on Netherite II, 5 s on Enderite III - Enderite III takes you to your own respawn point (bed or anchor) first. Tier I is smithed from any template, a light weighted pressure plate and an Enderman Head. The rising sound tells the waiting time; moving cancels it.
jei.simplebuilding.info.chunk_loader: Keeps chunks loaded: tier I its own chunk, Netherite (II) also the four chunks sharing an edge with it (5 chunks), Enderite (III) the 3x3 chunks around it. Releases only the chunks it forced itself. Tier I is smithed from any template, a copper pressure plate and a Copper Core.
jei.simplebuilding.info.launchpad: Right-click with wind charges to charge it, sneak + right-click loads all charges in your hand; the higher the sound, the fuller it is. Holds 4 (I), 8 (Netherite II) or 16 (Enderite III); stand on it for 3 s to be launched. Enderite: no fall damage until the next landing. Tier I is smithed from any template, a heavy weighted pressure plate and an Iron Core.
jei.simplebuilding.info.potion_pad: Throw a splash or lingering potion onto the pad to store its effects (a new potion replaces the old one, a water splash potion wipes it). Stand on it for 3 seconds: after 1 s you have 25 %, after 2 s 50 % and after 3 s the full duration of the effects at the potion's level - 30 s (I), 60 s (Reinforced II) or 120 s (Infused III). Instant effects (Healing, Harming) apply once, at the 3 s mark. The full application puts the pad on cooldown for twice the effect duration (60 / 120 / 240 s); stepping off early keeps what you got and starts no cooldown. The cooldown only runs while the pad is placed: broken, it keeps the remaining time, its potion and its easter stage. Unlimited uses; stacks to 1.
jei.simplebuilding.info.blaze_head: Dropped by a blaze killed by a charged creeper's explosion (one head per explosion, like the vanilla mob heads). Wearable and placeable; on top of a note block it plays the blaze sound. Smithed with any template onto a netherite pressure plate it makes the Potion Pad.
jei.simplebuilding.info.enderman_head: Dropped by an enderman killed by a charged creeper's explosion (one head per explosion, like the vanilla mob heads). Wearable and placeable; on top of a note block it plays the enderman sound. Smithed with any template onto a light weighted pressure plate it makes the Spawn Teleporter.
jei.simplebuilding.info.diamond_pressure: Only players press it; mobs and items do not.
jei.simplebuilding.info.netherite_pressu: With a barrel below it, only players carrying one of the barrel's items press it.
jei.simplebuilding.info.enderite_pressur: Owner-locked: the owner always presses it; with a barrel below also players named on a renamed name tag in it or carrying one of its items.
jei.simplebuilding.info.copper_pressure_: Powers only after a player has stood on it for 1-4 s, longer the more oxidized it is, and releases just as long after the player has stepped off. An axe scrapes one stage off; honeycomb waxes it (waxed plates stop oxidizing), an axe scrapes the wax off again.
jei.simplebuilding.info.spawn_elytra: Temporary elytra from the spawn area or an Elytra Pad; flight timer, boosts with jump while gliding.
jei.simplebuilding.info.laser_pointer: Hold right-click to show a dot where you aim, visible to nearby players. Held on a block for a moment the beam melts ice and snow, lights campfires, candles and soul fire, dries wet sponges, sets flammable blocks alight and primes TNT (never nether portals); held on a creature it sets it on fire (twice as long, players only with PvP). The farther away, the longer it takes (3 s up to 5 blocks, about 20 s at 200 blocks). Every use costs charge, even pointing into the air; an empty lens never breaks - recharge it in an anvil with redstone, no levels needed (64 redstone = full). With Constructor's Touch (book in an anvil) it also measures: distance, target block and height next to the crosshair, and it remembers the last measurement.
jei.simplebuilding.info.echo_compass: Right-click a lodestone to link it (clicking the lodestone it is already linked to does nothing), then hold use for 3 seconds to teleport onto it - no ender pearl needed (releasing early costs nothing); 24 s cooldown after a jump. One jump empties the echo sounder: recharge all 1500 points with Mending XP or echo shards at an anvil before it works normally again. Used while not fully recharged it charges for 6 seconds with warning signs and shatters after the jump.
jei.simplebuilding.info.astralit_ore: Generates in end stone near the top of the End islands; needs a diamond pickaxe. Drops Astralit Dust (Silk Touch: the ore itself).
jei.simplebuilding.info.nihilith_ore: Generates in end stone on the underside of the End islands; needs a diamond pickaxe. Drops Nihilit Shards (Silk Touch: the ore itself).
jei.simplebuilding.info.astralit_dust: Mined from Astralit Ore or found in End City chests. Armor trim material and an ingredient of Ender Quartz.
jei.simplebuilding.info.nihilith_shard: Mined from Nihilit Ore or found in End City chests. Armor trim material and an ingredient of Ender Quartz.

advancements.simplebuilding.hammer.heavy: Smith a Diamond Sledgehammer into Netherite: strong enough to hammer machines all the way to Enderite
advancements.simplebuilding.machines.rei: Craft a reinforced furnace, smoker, blast furnace, hopper or piston with Cracked Diamonds
advancements.simplebuilding.machines.for: Diamond Sledgehammer in hand, Netherite Nugget in the off hand: hold right-click on a placed reinforced machine until the fifth blow
advancements.simplebuilding.machines.end: Hammer a netherite machine into Enderite: a Netherite Sledgehammer and an Enderite Nugget do the trick
advancements.simplebuilding.chisel.chip_: Right-click a block with a chisel to turn it into the next block of its chain; sneak to go back
advancements.simplebuilding.chisel.fine_: Get a Diamond Chisel or better: higher tiers know more chains, and Constructor's Touch teaches even more
advancements.simplebuilding.tiers.step_b: Find a Basic Upgrade Smithing Template in a chest: at a smithing table it lifts a tool one tier - wood, stone, iron, gold, diamond
advancements.simplebuilding.wand.core_va: Masons and wandering traders sell Cores, chests hide them. A Core on two sticks is a Building Wand
advancements.simplebuilding.wand.one_cli: Click a block face with a Building Wand: it fills a whole square with blocks from your inventory
advancements.simplebuilding.wand.wand_er: Upgrade the wand with ever better Cores until it is Netherite - the better the core, the wider it builds
advancements.simplebuilding.octant.measu: Mark two corners with an Octant (sneak for the second): it shows distance, area and volume
advancements.simplebuilding.blueprint.co: Octant with a selection on top, blank Blueprint below: a cartography table scans the building into it
advancements.simplebuilding.blueprint.ca: Sign a Blueprint, then put it above a blank one in a cartography table to copy it
advancements.simplebuilding.blueprint.in: Building Wand in hand, signed Blueprint in the off hand: click the ground and watch the building rise
advancements.simplebuilding.gadgets.attr: An Iron Core, iron, redstone and lapis make a Magnet: hold it and loose items fly to you
advancements.simplebuilding.gadgets.spin: Turn a placed block right where it stands with a Rotator
advancements.simplebuilding.gadgets.burn: Hold the Amethyst Lens on ice, a candle, a campfire or a wet sponge until it gives in
advancements.simplebuilding.gadgets.ping: Hold an Ore Detector: its needle and a chime point you to the nearest ore
advancements.simplebuilding.gadgets.spee: A Copper Core, a compass, quartz and amethyst make a Velocity Gauge: see how fast you really are
advancements.simplebuilding.storage.shee: Nine leather make a Leather Sheet - backpacks, bundles and quivers are cut from it
advancements.simplebuilding.storage.pack: Craft a Backpack: wear it in the chest slot and open it with B, or set it down as a block
advancements.simplebuilding.storage.heav: Reinforce a backpack with Diamond Pebbles, then smith it into Netherite
advancements.simplebuilding.storage.bund: Diamond Pebbles and a Leather Sheet make a bundle hold half as much again
advancements.simplebuilding.storage.quiv: A Quiver holds only arrows and feeds your bow from the off hand, chest slot or hotbar
advancements.simplebuilding.end.stardust: Astralit Ore glitters on top of the End islands, Nihilit Ore hides beneath them: bring a diamond pickaxe
advancements.simplebuilding.end.quartz_f: Mix Astralit Dust, a Nihilit Shard and Quartz into Ender Quartz - Blueprints need it
advancements.simplebuilding.end.palette_: Craft End bricks: Astralit, Nihilit and Ender Quartz each make a whole building palette
advancements.simplebuilding.end.defying_: A Nihilit Shard keeps sand or gravel hanging in the air, Astralit Dust makes it rise
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.raw: Four Nihilit Shards, four Astralit Dust and an Ender Pearl make Raw Enderite - End cities hide some too
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.pat: Blast Raw Enderite into Enderite Scrap: a whole hour in a vanilla blast furnace - faster furnaces help
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.bey: Four Enderite Scrap, four diamonds and a Netherite Ingot forge an Enderite Ingot
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.poc: Split an Enderite Ingot into nuggets: they upgrade machines under the hammer and go into the Echo Sounder
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.ech: Link an Echo Sounder to a lodestone, then hold use for three seconds to jump onto it
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.tem: Find an Enderite Upgrade Smithing Template in an End city; diamonds and end stone copy it
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.cov: Smith a piece of netherite armor with an Enderite Upgrade Smithing Template and an Enderite Ingot
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.voi: Collect a full set of Enderite armor: it never falls into the void and lets you drift down gently
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.cut: Smith a netherite tool or weapon into Enderite
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.ham: Smith the Netherite Sledgehammer into Enderite: the strongest hammer there is
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.end: Smith a netherite bundle, quiver or backpack into Enderite
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.hea: Smith a Netherite Core into an Enderite Core - Flypads and the Echo Sounder want one
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.under_p: Craft a Diamond Pressure Plate: smithed with an elytra it makes an Elytra Pad, and it upgrades other pads
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.liftoff: Smith a Launchpad from a heavy pressure plate and an Iron Core, then step on it
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.wings_o: Stand on an Elytra Pad with an empty chest slot: it lends you a pair of wings
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.fly_me_: Stand above a Flypad - an Enderite Core smithed onto an Enderite Pressure Plate - and fly like in creative
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.home_sw: Stand still on a Spawn Teleporter until it takes you away
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.always_: Smith a Chunk Loader: it keeps its chunks ticking while you are away
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.hot_hea: Let a charged creeper blow up a Blaze: it drops a Blaze Head
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.bottoms: Smith a Blaze Head onto a Netherite Pressure Plate for a Potion Pad: splash a potion on it, then step on it
advancements.simplebuilding.building.roo: Chisels, building wands, octants and blueprints. Get any building tool to open this tab
Magnets, detectors, lenses and pads that launch, lend wings or carry you home
advancements.simplebuilding.end.root.des: The End hides new minerals and a metal stronger than netherite. Pick up some end stone to begin
advancements.simplebuilding.hammer.diamo: Nine Cracked Diamonds make a Block of Cracked Diamond - a compact store for the next machines
advancements.simplebuilding.hammer.brigh: Glowstone Dust instead of Glow Ink turns a trim template into an Emitting one
advancements.simplebuilding.tiers.copper: Craft a copper Chisel or Sledgehammer, or trade a Copper Core for a copper Building Wand
advancements.simplebuilding.tiers.ironcl: Get an iron Chisel, Sledgehammer or Building Wand - craft it, or upgrade the copper one with a Basic Upgrade Smithing Template
advancements.simplebuilding.tiers.golden: Gold tools are fast and enchant well: get a gold Chisel, Sledgehammer or Building Wand
advancements.simplebuilding.tiers.diamon: Get a diamond Chisel, Sledgehammer or Building Wand
advancements.simplebuilding.tiers.nether: Smith a diamond Chisel, Sledgehammer or Building Wand into Netherite
advancements.simplebuilding.storage.deep: Smith a Reinforced Bundle into a Netherite Bundle
advancements.simplebuilding.storage.shar: Reinforce a Quiver with Diamond Pebbles, then smith it into Netherite
advancements.simplebuilding.octant.colou: Craft an Octant with a dye to tell your selections apart; a cauldron washes the colour off again
advancements.simplebuilding.building.let: Glass, a torch and lapis make a Construction Light for dark building sites
advancements.simplebuilding.building.che: Craft a quartz checker block: quartz with purpur, lapis, blackstone, resin or an End mineral
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.copper_: A copper block makes Copper Pressure Plates: they press only after you stood on them a moment - the longer, the more they have weathered
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.higher_: Smith a Launchpad into Netherite: it holds twice as many wind charges
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.fine_fe: A Nether Star and a netherite template turn an Enderite Elytra Pad into the Fine Elytra Pad
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.stellar: Smith a Flypad up to the Stellar Flypad, its last tier
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.frequen: Smith a Spawn Teleporter up to tier III - it waits only 5 seconds and carries you to your own respawn point
advancements.simplebuilding.pads.infusio: Smith a Potion Pad up to the Infused Potion Pad
advancements.simplebuilding.tweaks.forbi: An apple or a carrot ringed with Netherite Nuggets is a meal that fights back
advancements.simplebuilding.tweaks.crown: Find an Enchanted Netherite Apple in a bastion treasure room, an ancient city or an ominous vault
advancements.simplebuilding.end.polished: Four end stone make Polished End Stone - the base of the astral and nihil blocks
advancements.simplebuilding.end.astral_p: Ring Astralit Dust or a Nihilit Shard with purpur or polished end stone
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.blo: Nine Enderite Ingots make a Block of Enderite
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.voi: An apple or a carrot ringed with Enderite Nuggets - stronger than its netherite cousin
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.the: Find an Enchanted Enderite Apple in an End city chest
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.mas: Smith a netherite Chisel or Building Wand into Enderite
advancements.simplebuilding.mining.all_i: Sneak while you mine ore with a Vein Miner pickaxe (or a log with a Vein Miner axe): the connected blocks come along
advancements.simplebuilding.mining.tunne: Sneak while you mine with a Strip Miner pickaxe: it digs a short tunnel straight ahead
advancements.simplebuilding.mining.right: The Right Tool for the Job
Sneak and hit a block with a Versatility tool: a better tool from your hotbar jumps into your hand
advancements.simplebuilding.hammer.demol: Break 10,000 blocks with sledgehammers around the block you hit
advancements.simplebuilding.hammer.full_: Add Radiance at the smithing table - Emitting template, armor, Glowstone Dust - until one armor piece shows Radiance 5
advancements.simplebuilding.trims.fashio: Wear four armor pieces trimmed with the same pattern that gives a bonus: the pattern's bonus counts four times
advancements.simplebuilding.machines.goo: Right-click a worn Netherite or Enderite Piston with its nugget to restore its full durability
advancements.simplebuilding.storage.pitc: Sneak and right-click a block with a backpack to set it down with everything inside
advancements.simplebuilding.storage.spla: Craft a backpack, bundle or quiver with a dye, just like leather armor
advancements.simplebuilding.chisel.sculp: Move blocks along their chains 1,000 times with a chisel
advancements.simplebuilding.wand.master_: Place 10,000 blocks with Building Wands - areas, Octant shapes and Blueprints all count
advancements.simplebuilding.gadgets.remo: Hold the Amethyst Lens beam on TNT until it lights
advancements.simplebuilding.tweaks.leap_: Wear boots with Air Jump and press jump again in mid-air
advancements.simplebuilding.tweaks.crump: Fly into a wall with an elytra while wearing armor with Kinetic Protection - it softens the blow
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.not: Throw an Enderite item into the void: instead of vanishing, it hangs below the world
advancements.simplebuilding.enderite.bro: Jump with an Echo Sounder that is not fully repaired: it gets you there, then shatters
quests.simplebuilding.group.title: SimpleBuilding
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.title: Stage 1: First Steps
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.subtitle: Vanilla basics and your first SimpleBuilding tools. Finish this chapter to unlock Stage 2.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.welcome.de: This book leads you through SimpleBuilding in four stages; each one unlocks when the previous one is done, the side chapters open along the way. Items you already carry or find by luck count too.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.guide_book: A book and a crafting table make the Beginner's Guide. Crafted with a matching item it becomes one of seven topic guides.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.stone_chis: Cobblestone, a copper nugget and a stick make a Stone Chisel.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.stone_sled: Cobblestone, an iron ingot and sticks make a Stone Sledgehammer: it mines 3x3 at once.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.leather_sh: Nine leather make a Leather Sheet - backpacks, bundles and quivers are cut from it.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.trade.hint: Masons (from level 2) and wandering traders sell Copper Cores.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.copper_cor: Buy a Copper Core from a mason or a wandering trader. Every building wand is built around a core.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.copper_wan: A Copper Core on two sticks is a Copper Building Wand.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.done.title: Stage 1 Complete
quests.simplebuilding.stage_1.done.hint: Finish every quest of this chapter and craft an iron pickaxe to unlock Stage 2.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_2.title: Stage 2: Iron & Diamonds
quests.simplebuilding.stage_2.subtitle: Better tiers, diamond pebbles and the first reinforced machines. Finish this chapter to unlock Stage 3.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_2.diamond_bl: Nine diamonds make a Block of Diamond - a sledgehammer crushes it into Diamond Pebbles.
SimpleBuilding adds its own enchantments for chisels, hammers, wands and storage - look for them in chests and villager trades.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_2.done.title: Stage 2 Complete
quests.simplebuilding.stage_2.done.hint: Finish every quest of this chapter and step through a Nether portal to unlock Stage 3.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_3.title: Stage 3: The Nether
quests.simplebuilding.stage_3.subtitle: Netherite tools, machines hammered in place and the first pads. Finish this chapter to unlock Stage 4.
Four netherite scrap and four gold ingots make a Netherite Ingot.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_3.netherite_: Bastion treasure rooms always hold a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template; diamonds and netherrack copy it. Every netherite tier of SimpleBuilding is smithed with it.
Smith a heavy weighted pressure plate with an Iron Core and any template.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_3.netherite_: Smith a Diamond Pressure Plate into Netherite: the base of the Potion Pad and of every netherite pad tier.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_3.done.title: Stage 3 Complete
quests.simplebuilding.stage_3.done.hint: Finish every quest of this chapter and follow an Eye of Ender to a stronghold to unlock Stage 4.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_4.title: Stage 4: The End and Beyond
quests.simplebuilding.stage_4.subtitle: New minerals, enderite and the strongest tier of every tool.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_4.wither.hin: Iron, gold and diamond cores are crafted around a Nether Star, and the netherite and enderite cores are smithed from the diamond one.
quests.simplebuilding.stage_4.done.title: Void Walker
quests.simplebuilding.stage_4.done.hint: The last quest of the SimpleBuilding stages. Congratulations!
quests.simplebuilding.building.title: Building & Blueprints
quests.simplebuilding.building.subtitle: Side chapter: chisels, wands, octants and blueprints. Opens with your first chisel.
quests.simplebuilding.building.guide.des: The Beginner's Guide crafted with a brick is the building guide.
quests.simplebuilding.building.octant.de: A compass, a lightning rod, a lead and the two weighted pressure plates make an Octant.
quests.simplebuilding.building.rotator.h: The Rotator needs an Iron Core - woodland mansions hide them.
quests.simplebuilding.building.blueprint: Paper, an ink sac and Ender Quartz make a blank Blueprint.
quests.simplebuilding.storage.title: Storage
quests.simplebuilding.storage.subtitle: Side chapter: backpacks, bundles and quivers, from leather to enderite. Opens with your first backpack.
quests.simplebuilding.storage.bundle.des: Leather and string make a bundle - the base of the Quiver and the Reinforced Bundle.
quests.simplebuilding.storage.guide.desc: Everything about backpacks, bundles and quivers in one topic guide.
quests.simplebuilding.storage.reinforced: Diamond Pebbles, a Leather Sheet and string reinforce a backpack: more room for your things.
Diamond Pebbles and a Leather Sheet reinforce a quiver, just like a bundle.
quests.simplebuilding.gadgets.title: Gadgets & Tweaks
quests.simplebuilding.gadgets.subtitle: Side chapter: gadgets, pressure plates and pads. Opens right at the start.
quests.simplebuilding.gadgets.guide.desc: Every pad and gadget explained in one topic guide.
quests.simplebuilding.gadgets.leap_of_fa: Air Jump is an enchanted book found in chests; it goes on boots.
quests.simplebuilding.gadgets.detector.h: The Ore Detector needs a Gold Core - bastions and fortresses hide them.
quests.simplebuilding.gadgets.spawn.hint: Smith a light weighted pressure plate with an Enderman Head - a charged creeper's explosion knocks one off an enderman.
book.simplebuilding.guide.title: Beginner's Guide
book.simplebuilding.guide.1.title: First Steps
book.simplebuilding.guide.1.text: SimpleBuilding adds tools for building, mining and storage. This guide walks you through the first hours; click a chapter in the contents to jump there.
book.simplebuilding.guide.2.title: Stone Chisel
book.simplebuilding.guide.2.text: Your first tool: a stick bottom left, cobblestone in the middle, a copper nugget left of it and one below it. Right-click stone: chiseled stone bricks. Sneaking turns it back.
book.simplebuilding.guide.3.title: Sledgehammer
book.simplebuilding.guide.3.text: Iron ingot top left, two cobblestone beside it, two sticks below the middle. Mines a 3x3 face of the same block; sneaking mines one. Hold right-click: block to stairs to slab.
book.simplebuilding.guide.4.title: Diamond Pebbles
book.simplebuilding.guide.4.text: Hold right-click with the hammer on a diamond block: 81 Diamond Pebbles. Nine make a Cracked Diamond, the material of Reinforced furnaces, hoppers and pistons.
book.simplebuilding.guide.5.title: Hammer Upgrades
book.simplebuilding.guide.5.text: Netherite Nugget in your off hand, Diamond Sledgehammer or better: hold right-click on a Reinforced machine for 5 seconds and it turns Netherite.
book.simplebuilding.guide.6.title: Building Wand
book.simplebuilding.guide.6.text: Copper Core top right, two sticks diagonally below. Blocks in your off hand or hotbar, right-click a face: a 3x3 layer. Sneak + right-click into the air: undo.
book.simplebuilding.guide.7.title: Octant
book.simplebuilding.guide.7.text: Measures and plans: right-click sets Pos 1, sneak + right-click Pos 2, and you see distance, area or volume. Recipe: weighted pressure plates, lightning rods, lead, compass.
book.simplebuilding.guide.8.title: Backpack
book.simplebuilding.guide.8.text: Leather Sheet: 9 leather. Backpack: 2 copper nuggets, string, 3 Leather Sheets, 3 heavy weighted pressure plates. Wear it in the chest slot and open it with %2$s.
book.simplebuilding.guide.9.title: Better Tools
book.simplebuilding.guide.9.text: Basic Upgrade Smithing Template at the smithing table: copper to iron, iron to gold, gold to diamond; enchantments stay. Then the Netherite and the Enderite templates.
book.simplebuilding.guide.10.title: Enchantments
book.simplebuilding.guide.10.text: The enchanting table only offers Fast Chiseling; the rest are books from chests and traders. Constructor's Touch unlocks the wand menu (%1$s).
book.simplebuilding.tools.title: Tools & Upgrades
book.simplebuilding.tools.intro: Chisels, hammers and gadgets, and how to make them stronger.
book.simplebuilding.tools.1.title: Chisel Tiers
book.simplebuilding.tools.1.text: Stone up to enderite: higher tiers know more conversions. Fast Chiseling shortens the cooldown; Constructor's Touch adds conversions.
book.simplebuilding.tools.2.title: Hammer Enchants
book.simplebuilding.tools.2.text: Override I takes all pickaxe blocks, II everything breakable. Radius makes 3x3 into 5x5. Break Through digs 1 or 2 layers deeper. Each extra block costs 1 durability.
book.simplebuilding.tools.3.title: Upgrade Costs
book.simplebuilding.tools.3.text: The Basic Upgrade Smithing Template costs twice the crafting material: pickaxe or axe 6, sword or hoe 4, shovel 2, chisel 2, sledgehammer 22. A wand takes one core of the new tier.
book.simplebuilding.tools.4.title: Magnet & Rotator
book.simplebuilding.tools.4.text: The Magnet pulls items within 4 blocks while you hold it. The Rotator turns logs, furnaces, pistons and hoppers in place; recharge it with ender pearls at an anvil.
book.simplebuilding.tools.5.title: Ore Detector
book.simplebuilding.tools.5.text: A compass for ores: the needle points to the nearest ore of the chosen mode; rock in between weakens the signal. Needs a Gold Core, sold by the Wandering Trader.
book.simplebuilding.tools.6.title: Mining Enchants
book.simplebuilding.tools.6.text: Sneak to use them: Vein Miner breaks a whole ore vein, Strip Miner digs a short tunnel, Versatility switches to the best tool on your hotbar.
book.simplebuilding.building.title: Building
book.simplebuilding.building.intro: Building Wand, Octant and Blueprint: build big, plan ahead.
book.simplebuilding.building.1.title: Wand Tiers
book.simplebuilding.building.1.text: Copper 3x3, iron 5x5, gold 7x7, diamond 9x9, netherite 11x11, enderite 13x13. Each block costs one item and 1 durability. A ghost preview shows where it builds.
book.simplebuilding.building.2.title: Wand Enchants
book.simplebuilding.building.2.text: Linear: sneak-click builds a line. Color Palette mixes the blocks you carry. Master Builder takes blocks from your whole inventory. Constructor's Touch opens the settings (%1$s).
book.simplebuilding.building.3.title: Octant Shapes
book.simplebuilding.building.3.text: Hold an Octant with both corners set in your off hand: the wand fills its shape. With stairs as material, prisms and pyramids become a roof.
book.simplebuilding.building.4.title: Blueprint
book.simplebuilding.building.4.text: Ender Quartz, paper and an ink sac. Write a build code or insert an example, sign it, then hold it in your off hand with a wand in your main hand and click.
book.simplebuilding.building.5.title: Scanning
book.simplebuilding.building.5.text: In a cartography table: an Octant with both corners on top, an empty Blueprint below. The Blueprint copies the selected building; the Octant stays.
book.simplebuilding.building.6.title: Undo & Hunger
book.simplebuilding.building.6.text: Sneak + right-click into the air undoes your last build. Very large builds make you hungry; normal wand clicks are free.
book.simplebuilding.storage.title: Storage
book.simplebuilding.storage.1.title: Bundles
book.simplebuilding.storage.1.text: Reinforced Bundle 96 items, Netherite 192, Enderite 288. Reinforced: bundle, string, Diamond Pebble and Leather Sheet; the next tiers come from the smithing table.
book.simplebuilding.storage.2.title: Quivers
book.simplebuilding.storage.2.text: Arrows only: 64, 96, 128 or 192 by tier. In your off hand, chest slot or hotbar it feeds your bow. Quiver: bundle, string, leather and a copper nugget.
book.simplebuilding.storage.3.title: Backpacks
book.simplebuilding.storage.3.text: Four tiers: 9, 18, 33 and 50 slots. Wear it in the chest slot and press %2$s. Sneak + right-click on a block sets it down with everything inside. Dye it like leather.
book.simplebuilding.storage.4.title: Enchantments
book.simplebuilding.storage.4.text: Deep Pockets: more room. Funnel: picks items up for you. Drawer: more room, but at most 5 item types. Master Builder: the Building Wand takes blocks from the backpack.
book.simplebuilding.machines.title: Machines & Pistons
book.simplebuilding.machines.intro: Faster hoppers and furnaces, stronger pistons and sand that ignores gravity.
book.simplebuilding.machines.1.title: Hoppers
book.simplebuilding.machines.1.text: Reinforced 4 ticks per item, Netherite 2, Enderite 1 (vanilla: 8). Each has a filter button - Disabled, Exact Match or Type Match - and one filter item per slot.
book.simplebuilding.machines.2.title: Furnaces
book.simplebuilding.machines.2.text: Reinforced furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces run 2x as fast, Netherite 4x, Enderite 8x. Netherite and Enderite machines give double experience.
book.simplebuilding.machines.3.title: Building Them
book.simplebuilding.machines.3.text: Reinforced: the vanilla machine plus Cracked Diamonds at the crafting table. Netherite and Enderite have no recipe: hammer them in the world (see the Beginner's Guide).
book.simplebuilding.machines.4.title: Pistons
book.simplebuilding.machines.4.text: Reinforced Pistons push longer lines and, paid with a Redstone Block, one unbreakable block. Netherite and Enderite Pistons break blocks based on signal strength.
book.simplebuilding.machines.5.title: Gravity Blocks
book.simplebuilding.machines.5.text: Suspended Sand and Suspended Gravel hang in mid-air. Levitating Sand and Levitating Gravel rise upwards on their own.
book.simplebuilding.end.title: End & Enderite
book.simplebuilding.end.intro: New ores, the Enderite tier and three End palettes.
book.simplebuilding.end.1.title: End Ores
book.simplebuilding.end.1.text: Astralit Ore grows on top of the End islands, Nihilit Ore on their underside. Both need a diamond pickaxe and give trim materials.
book.simplebuilding.end.2.title: Enderite
book.simplebuilding.end.2.text: End city chests hold Raw Enderite and Enderite Nuggets. At the smithing table: Enderite Upgrade Smithing Template + netherite item + Enderite Ingot.
book.simplebuilding.end.3.title: Void Safe
book.simplebuilding.end.3.text: Enderite items do not fall out of the world: below the bottom they hang in place. Enderite armor slows void damage and lets you drift down while you hold jump.
book.simplebuilding.end.4.title: End Palettes
book.simplebuilding.end.4.text: Pink Astralit, blue Nihilit and purple Ender Quartz: bricks, stairs, slabs, walls, pillars and chiseled blocks. Every Astralit block glows.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.title: Pads & Gadgets
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.intro: Pressure plates and pads from Simple Tweaks, plus a few gadgets.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.1.title: Pressure Plates
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.1.text: Diamond plates react to players only. Copper plates wait until a player has stood on them for a while. Enderite plates answer only to their owner and allowed players.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.2.title: Elytra & Launch
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.2.text: Elytra Pads give a Spawn Elytra to players with an empty chest slot. Launchpads charged with wind charges launch you after 3 seconds.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.3.title: Fly & Teleport
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.3.text: Flypads let you fly inside their area. Stand still on a Spawn Teleporter to travel: 50 seconds on tier I, 20 on II, 5 on III, which takes you to your own respawn point.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.4.title: Potions & Chunks
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.4.text: Throw a splash potion onto a Potion Pad: players who step on get its effects. Chunk Loaders keep chunks loaded. Pad upgrades pay with the pressure plate of the new material.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.5.title: Echo Sounder
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.5.text: Right-click a lodestone to link it, then hold use for 3 seconds to jump onto it. Afterwards it rests 24 seconds.
book.simplebuilding.trims.title: Trims & Radiance
book.simplebuilding.trims.intro: Armor trims with real bonuses, and armor that shines.
book.simplebuilding.trims.1.title: Trim Bonuses
book.simplebuilding.trims.1.text: Trim patterns and materials give bonuses: less damage of a kind, speed, experience, luck and more, listed in the tooltip. Astralit, Nihilit and Enderite are new materials.
book.simplebuilding.trims.2.title: Resonance
book.simplebuilding.trims.2.text: How strong the bonuses are grows with your experience, the time you have played since your last death and your fights. Dying resets part of it.
book.simplebuilding.trims.3.title: Radiance
book.simplebuilding.trims.3.text: Hit a smithing template in an item frame with a sledgehammer, Glowstone Dust in your off hand: an Emitting Trim Smithing Template. With dust at the smithing table it adds radiance.
book.simplebuilding.trims.4.title: Light & Glow
book.simplebuilding.trims.4.text: Radiance goes up to 5, and worn armor lights up the blocks around you. A Glow Ink Sac instead makes the Glowing template: the trim glows but gives no light.
book.simplebuilding.trims.5.title: Trim Icons
book.simplebuilding.trims.5.text: Trimmed armor shows its pattern on the item icon in the colors of its material, so you can tell trims apart without wearing them.
book.simplebuilding.tools.7.title: Armor Enchants
book.simplebuilding.tools.7.text: Air Jump on boots: press jump again in mid-air for one more jump, then it rests 5 seconds (half at level II). Kinetic Protection on armor softens hitting a wall in flight.
book.simplebuilding.tools.8.title: Range
book.simplebuilding.tools.8.text: Range lets chisels, mining tools, sledgehammers and octants reach farther: 2 more blocks at level I, 6 at level II and 10 at level III.
book.simplebuilding.building.7.title: Bridge
book.simplebuilding.building.7.text: Stand at an edge and right-click into the air: a wand with Bridge builds straight ahead across the gap.
book.simplebuilding.building.8.title: Cover
book.simplebuilding.building.8.text: With Cover, only faces of the block type you clicked get a layer. Cover goes with neither Bridge nor Linear.
book.simplebuilding.building.9.title: Construction Light
book.simplebuilding.building.9.text: Four lapis, four glass and a torch in the middle make a Construction Light. It shines at full brightness, but its light does not keep monsters from spawning.
book.simplebuilding.building.10.title: Quartz Checkers
book.simplebuilding.building.10.text: Two quartz blocks crossed with two of purpur, lapis block, blackstone, red nether bricks, Astralit Dust, Nihilit Shard or Ender Quartz: four checker blocks.
book.simplebuilding.end.5.title: Enderite Food
book.simplebuilding.end.5.text: Eight Enderite Nuggets around an apple or four around a carrot: the Enderite Apple heals and shields you, the Enderite Carrot gives night vision, speed and jump boost.
book.simplebuilding.end.6.title: Enderite Spear
book.simplebuilding.end.6.text: Smith a netherite spear with the Enderite Upgrade Smithing Template and an Enderite Ingot. Like all Enderite gear it does not burn and does not fall out of the world.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.6.title: Echo Charge
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.6.text: One jump empties the echo sounder. Mending or echo shards at an anvil recharge it - 4 shards fill it. Used before it is full, it still jumps, then shatters.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.7.title: Amethyst Lens
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.7.text: Hold right-click for a red dot. Kept on a spot, the beam melts ice and snow, lights campfires and candles, dries sponges, sets things on fire and primes TNT.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.8.title: Lens Charge
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.8.text: Every use costs charge, even pointing into the air. An empty lens never breaks: recharge it at an anvil with redstone, no levels needed - 64 redstone fill it.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.9.title: Velocity Gauge
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.9.text: Hold it in either hand: a dial shows your speed in blocks per second. With Constructor's Touch it adds your top and average speed.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.10.title: Blaze Head
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.10.text: A blaze killed by a charged creeper's explosion drops its head. Wear it or place it; on a note block it plays the blaze sound. Smithed onto a netherite pressure plate: the Potion Pad.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.11.title: Netherite Food
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.11.text: Eight Netherite Nuggets around an apple: fire resistance, resistance, absorption and regeneration. Four around a carrot: fire resistance and night vision.
book.simplebuilding.trims.6.title: Placing Templates
book.simplebuilding.trims.6.text: Sneak and right-click with a smithing template to lay it on the floor, a wall or the ceiling. A placed trim template takes three sledgehammer hits to upgrade.
book.simplebuilding.admin.title: Server Admin
book.simplebuilding.admin.intro: Commands and config switches for servers and modpacks.
book.simplebuilding.admin.1.title: Commands
book.simplebuilding.admin.1.text: Every SimpleBuilding command needs an operator; the console and command blocks cannot use them.
book.simplebuilding.admin.2.title: Reading Options
book.simplebuilding.admin.2.text: /simplebuilding config list shows every option; a filter like tweaks.pads narrows it. /simplebuilding config get shows value and default.
book.simplebuilding.admin.3.title: Changing Options
book.simplebuilding.admin.3.text: /simplebuilding config set changes an option, /simplebuilding config reset restores its default. Both keep the file's limits and save it at once.
book.simplebuilding.admin.4.title: Pads & Spawn
book.simplebuilding.admin.4.text: /simplebuilding tweaks pads switches pad types on or off, e.g. tweaks.pads.enableFlypads. /simplebuilding tweaks worldspawn setspawn1 aims every Spawn Teleporter where you stand.
book.simplebuilding.admin.5.title: Vehicles
book.simplebuilding.admin.5.text: /killboats and /killcarts clear unoccupied vehicles within tweaks.commands.killCommandRadius. /killcarts is off until tweaks.commands.enableKillCartsCommand.
book.simplebuilding.admin.6.title: World Switches
book.simplebuilding.admin.6.text: giveGuideBookOnFirstJoin: the Beginner's Guide on the first join. worldGen.enableLootTableChanges: the mod's loot; it applies on /reload.
book.simplebuilding.building.11.title: Small Tricks
book.simplebuilding.building.11.text: Right-click placed wool with shears: it turns back into 4 string. A water cauldron washes the dye off Octants, backpacks, bundles and quivers.
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.12.title: Waxing Plates
book.simplebuilding.tweaks.12.text: Copper pressure plates oxidize like copper blocks, and the more oxidized, the longer they wait. Honeycomb waxes them so they stay as they are; an axe scrapes off wax or one stage.
book.simplebuilding.admin.7.title: Trade Switches
book.simplebuilding.admin.7.text: worldGen.enableVillagerTrades and worldGen.enableWanderingTrades add the mod's trades; both apply on /reload.
book.simplebuilding.admin.8.title: Gameplay Switches
book.simplebuilding.admin.8.text: trimBenefitBaseMultiplier: trim bonus strength. airJumpCooldownTicks: the Air Jump rest. breakerPistonsLoseDurability: piston wear. tools.buildingWandHungerCost: wand hunger.
Rules for those who make them.
book.simplebuilding.guide.topics.title: Topic Books
book.simplebuilding.guide.topics.text: Book or this guide + item at the crafting table; the guide stays:
gui.simplebuilding.guide.locked: Not in your inventory. Craft it: Book + %s
text.autoconfig.simplebuilding.option.gi: Every player gets the Beginner's Guide once, the first time they join a world or server. Off: nothing is given; switched on later, each player gets it once on their next join. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplebuilding.title: SimpleBuilding Settings
text.autoconfig.simplebuilding.option.to: Multiplies the food exhaustion of every block past the free allowance (see Building Wand Hunger Cost). 0.5 = half as hungry, 2 = twice as hungry, 0 = building is free. The free allowance itself stays. Server-side. Default: 1.0.
Multiplies how far the Magnet pulls items (4 blocks, 8 with Constructor's Touch, +2 per Radius level). 2 = twice as far, 0 = the Magnet pulls nothing. Server-side. Default: 1.0.

Charge one turn of the Rotator uses up (a full Rotator holds 1024, 16 Ender Pearls refill it). 0 = turning is free, 2 = half as many turns per charge. Unbreaking still applies. Server-side. Default: 1.
text.autoconfig.simplebuilding.option.tw: Off: potion pads keep their potion but give no effects. Default: on.
How long a player has to stand still on a spawn teleporter I before it teleports, in ticks (20 = 1 s). Default: 1000 (50 s).
The same for spawn teleporter II. Default: 400 (20 s).
The same for the Enderite spawn teleporter III (the final easter stage waits half as long). Default: 100 (5 s).
Multiplies the launch strength of launchpads (1.5 plus 0.8 per wind charge). 0.5 = half as high, 2 = twice as strong. Default: 1.0.
A player standing on a potion pad gets 25 %, 50 % and then 100 % of the effect duration in three steps; this is the length of one step in ticks. Default: 20 (1 s, full after 3 s).
After a full charge the potion pad cools down for this many times the effect duration. 0 = no cooldown. Default: 2.0.
Charge the lens uses up for every started second of beaming (a full lens holds 640, one Redstone Dust recharges 10). 0 = beaming is free. Default: 1.
Charge used up each time the beam melts, lights, dries or ignites something. 0 = effects are free. Default: 5.
How many firework rockets fit in one stack (1 to 64); 16 nerfs elytra flight. Server-side, sent to clients. Default: 64.
Cooldown of the Echo Sounder after a jump to its lodestone, in ticks (20 = 1 s). 0 = no cooldown. Default: 480 (24 s).
X of the target of all spawn teleporters; set it with /simplebuilding tweaks worldspawn setspawn1. Default: 0.
Y of the target of all spawn teleporters; set it with /simplebuilding tweaks worldspawn setspawn1. -1000 = not set (world spawn). Default: -1000.
Z of the target of all spawn teleporters; set it with /simplebuilding tweaks worldspawn setspawn1. Default: 0.
How far around the player /killboats and /killcarts reach, in blocks. Default: 100.
How far an orb reaches to merge its neighbours, in blocks. Larger = fewer orbs. Default: 2.0.
text.autoconfig.simplebuilding.option.wo: Multiplies the (very small) chance of building cores in loot chests, at most one per chest. 0 = no cores in chests. Applies on world start or /reload. Default: 1.0.
commands.simplebuilding.config.invalid: "%s" is not a valid %s value for %s
commands.simplebuilding.config.client_si: This option is client-side: it changes only the server file, not what players see.
commands.simplebuilding.config.on_reload: Takes effect when the data packs load (/reload or world start).
